四级核心词汇 · 02英文原文

The Shadow Above the Curtain

幕布上方的影子 · 598 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A town theater planned a traditional ceremony for its hundredth year. The brochure promised a silver dove above the curtain. Lian came to help with the decoration and saw only a dull blur on the wall. The director wanted an artificial bird on a cable. His reputation depended on a brilliant show, he said. Lian wanted the effect to be authentic. Before the company bought a substitute, she asked why the original image had faded.

2She climbed a narrow stair to the attic. A damp cabinet held a bundle of sketches, a cotton collar, and an oval lid. Underneath, a dusty mirror leaned against a brick. A note behind a panel said to move it aside before lighting the stage. The command sounded vague. Why take away a mirror when the room lacked light? Lian wiped the glass with a rag and saw a deliberate scratch in the shape of an arrow.

3An antique catalog listed an amateur company's lamp beside a spare needle and scissors. A colleague had inherited a trunk from the tailor who sewed its costumes. Inside lay a cape, a pearl button, and a plain cotton sheet. The tailor's granddaughter recalled a graceful figure in a fancy disguise. A dove had followed her across the curtain while a poet read a romantic poem. She remembered the poetry. How the dove seemed to vanish remained a puzzle.

4At first, Lian assumed the sheet was a costume. A glance revealed a seam on each side. A slender loop ran along one section and fit over a horizontal rod. The sheet had served as a screen. She set the mirror upright and aimed it upward. The reflection landed below the screen. That explained the blurred circle. Someone had replaced the lamp with a brighter one and mounted it too low. Its beam never reached the silver surface.

5Lian asked the actors to compare two versions of the scene. A vivid painted bird filled the screen, but it had a fixed pose. The original shadow seemed to breathe. The director had thought a dramatic scene needed decoration to enhance it. The simple technique had enough merit to entertain without a painted masterpiece.

6The director was reluctant to delay the forthcoming rehearsal. Lian made an earnest appeal for one hour. She tied a knot in the string, raised the mirror by an inch, and covered the outer edge with black cloth. An actor held a cutout next to the lamp. At first its wings had different lengths. A twist of his wrist made the shape leap into view. The sheet hid the lamp without blocking the dynamic image.

7A loose nail made the rod sway, so a skillful carpenter reinforced its support. Lian chose a durable strip and fastened it with help from a ladder. The company adjusted the timing to the rhythm. An enthusiastic actor stepped too far ahead and cast the shadow of his elbow. Instead of trying to imitate a bird, he marked his position with chalk. On the next attempt his movement looked elegant enough to belong to the dance.

8The audience saw a plain stage. From the front bench, the tailor's granddaughter recognized the dove and gave a grin. After the performance, she called it marvelous and asked if it had been restored. Lian showed her the scratched mirror and sheet. Their combination was the genius of the effect. The theater put both in a display, with a diagram of the angle. The director left the chalk mark in recognition of the actor's discovery. A splendid scene had begun with knowing where to stand.

四级核心词汇 · 02中文译文

幕布上方的影子

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1镇上的剧院准备按传统办一场百年庆典。宣传册说，幕布上方会出现一只银色鸽子。莲来帮忙布置，却只看见墙上一团暗淡的影子。导演想用钢索吊一只人造的鸟。他说，一场出色的演出关系到自己的名声。莲想把当年的效果还原。剧团买替代品之前，她想先查清楚，原来的影像是怎么消失的。

2她沿窄楼梯爬到阁楼。潮湿的柜子里放着一捆草图、一条棉布衣领和一个椭圆形的盖子。柜子下面，一面蒙灰的镜子靠着砖块。镶板后有一张纸条，交代点亮舞台前先把镜子挪开。这道指令说得含糊。屋里已经够暗了，为什么还要把镜子挪走？莲拿抹布擦了擦镜面，发现有人刻意划了一个箭头。

3一册旧目录记着业余剧团当年用过的灯，旁边还有备用的针和剪刀。一位同事从当年缝戏服的裁缝那里继承了一口箱子。里面装着一件披风、一枚珍珠扣和一张素棉布。裁缝的孙女记得，一个身影穿着花哨的戏服，姿态优雅。一位诗人朗诵浪漫的诗句时，鸽子一路跟着那个身影掠过幕布。她还记得诗，可鸽子为什么会突然消失，始终是个谜。

4莲起初以为棉布是件戏服。仔细一看，两边都缝了边。其中一段缝成细长的套，刚好能穿过一根横杆。原来棉布是用来当幕的。莲扶正镜子，把它朝上调整，反光却落在幕布下方。这解释了那团模糊的圆影。有人换了一盏更亮的灯，却把它装得太低，光始终没照到银色的镜面上。

5莲让演员们对比两种效果。一只颜色鲜明的画鸽占满幕布，姿势却是固定的。原来的影子仿佛会呼吸。导演原本以为，得靠布景才能增强场面的戏剧效果。现在他看见，一个简单的技巧已经能吸引观众，画得再精致也未必有同样的效果。

6导演不愿耽搁接下来的排练。莲诚恳地争取到一个小时。她在细绳上打结，把镜子抬高一英寸，再用黑布遮住外沿。一名演员在灯旁举起剪出的鸟形。起初，影子的一边翅膀比另一边长。他一转手腕，整只鸟像突然跃了出来。那张棉布遮住灯，却没挡住活动的影像。

7一枚松动的钉子让横杆晃来晃去，一位手艺好的木工便加固了支撑。莲选了条结实的布，借着梯子把它固定好。剧团调整灯光时机，让它跟上音乐节奏。一名热情的演员跨早了一步，把自己的手肘影子投到了幕上。他没有刻意模仿鸟，只用粉笔标出了该站的位置。下一次，那动作优雅得像本来就是舞蹈的一部分。

8观众看到的舞台布置很朴素。坐在前排长凳上的裁缝孙女认出了鸽子，咧嘴一笑。演出后，她说效果妙极了，问是不是恢复了老机关。莲给她看那面有划痕的镜子和棉布。奥妙就在于两者的配合。剧院把它们放进展柜，旁边配了一张角度图。导演也留着地上的粉笔印，记下那位演员的发现。一幕精彩的戏，就从知道该站在哪里开始。
